method_original: train-only Q95(abs(stakeholder component)) / Q95(unweighted tracking loss)
retention_basis: The original 12 scenario labels and 1,500 component-level observations were subsequently recovered in a private July 2026 workbook; a historical-environment replay matched the archived components to floating-point tolerance and reproduced the reported calibration statistics. These materials are not included in this public repository pending rights review. The separate deterministic quantile-sampling diagnostic is not a replay of the original sample, and its alternative coefficients were not substituted. The original coefficient was retained without adjustment based on validation or test performance.
caution: Independent reviewer replays are transcribed from the supplied review; full replay logs were not provided. They are not claimed to reproduce the original archived calibration scenarios.
alternative_capacity_protocol: Hold the same lambda_c for 6/8 kW; recompute automatic economic normalisation and delta=0.1033/Lcap. Separate future sensitivity runs are not launched by this 7-kW script.
historical_recovery_note: Original scenario identifiers and records have been recovered privately, but the historical workbook, licensed data and historical source snapshot are not publicly distributed. Reproduction on the historical inputs is distinct from recalibration in the final forecast-state environment.
